document_measurement_review.notes:
geometry: Polygons use clear room faces derived directly from A101/A102 dimensions and the offset rules stated on G000 (100 mm from external CL; 75 mm from internal CL). The 3.000 x 6.000 m stair rectangle is modelled as its own VOID space (evidence A201/A302) to ensure the benchmark’s explicit deduction from G04/F04 floors and C03 soffits. No inferred adjustments were made to reach target totals. If a hole-geometry ring is required for the G04/F04 polygons, the source supports exactly the same 18.000 m2 stair opening at X25–28 / Y1–7.
structure: This benchmark is a fit‑out-only measurement set. Structural concrete, reinforcement, excavation and formwork are explicitly excluded on G000 (01/13) and A201 confirms no structural reinforcement scope (04/13). No member dimensions or slab thicknesses are issued. Therefore no structural-operation calculations are provided in this pass.
